datasets.name: ov_lgu
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY national_order, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       national_order, city_mun_psgc_code, city_mun_name, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
       region_short, queue_status, queue_sort, status_label, status_basis, pressure_signals, classroom_signal,
       teacher_signal, growth_signal, priority_affected_learners,
       format_number(priority_affected_learners, 0) AS affected_txt, ap2_affected_learners, data_readiness,
       not_assessed_reason_txt
FROM pri
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:queue = 'All review statuses' OR queue_status = :queue) AND (:coverage = 'All LGUs' OR (:coverage = 'Assessed' AND queue_status <> 'Data review') OR (:coverage = 'Insufficient data' AND queue_status = 'Data review'))) AS r
ORDER BY rank_in_view

                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
k AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS lgus,
         COUNT_IF(queue_status <> 'Data review') AS assessed,
         COUNT_IF(queue_status = 'Priority 1') AS joint_review,
         COUNT_IF(queue_status IN ('Priority 1', 'Priority 2', 'Priority 3')) AS any_pressure,
         COUNT_IF(queue_status = 'Data review') AS data_review,
         SUM(COALESCE(congested_school_count, 0)) AS schools_above,
         SUM(COALESCE(ap2_affected_learners, 0)) AS learners_above,

-- each KPI is written whole here, so Databricks never abbreviates a count to 1.38K
SELECT k.*,

FROM k

SELECT classroom_signal, teacher_signal, format_number(COUNT(*), 0) AS lgus,
       format_number(COUNT_IF(growth_signal = 'Growing'), 0) AS growing,
       CASE WHEN classroom_signal = 'Present' AND teacher_signal = 'Present' THEN 'Priority 1 if growing, else Priority 2'
            WHEN classroom_signal = 'Present' OR teacher_signal = 'Present' THEN 'Priority 2 if growing, else Priority 3'
            WHEN classroom_signal = 'Not identified' AND teacher_signal = 'Not identified' THEN 'Monitor if growing, else no current pressure'
            ELSE 'Data review' END AS resulting_status
FROM (WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY national_order, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       national_order, city_mun_psgc_code, city_mun_name, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
       region_short, queue_status, queue_sort, status_label, status_basis, pressure_signals, classroom_signal,
       teacher_signal, growth_signal, priority_affected_learners,
       format_number(priority_affected_learners, 0) AS affected_txt, ap2_affected_learners, data_readiness,
       not_assessed_reason_txt
FROM pri
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:queue = 'All review statuses' OR queue_status = :queue) AND (:coverage = 'All LGUs' OR (:coverage = 'Assessed' AND queue_status <> 'Data review') OR (:coverage = 'Insufficient data' AND queue_status = 'Data review'))) AS r
GROUP BY classroom_signal, teacher_signal
ORDER BY CASE classroom_signal WHEN 'Present' THEN 0 WHEN 'Not identified' THEN 1 WHEN 'Not assessed' THEN 2 END, CASE teacher_signal WHEN 'Present' THEN 0 WHEN 'Not identified' THEN 1 WHEN 'Not assessed' THEN 2 END

  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,

              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY national_order, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       national_order, city_mun_psgc_code, city_mun_name, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
       region_short, queue_status, queue_sort, status_label, status_basis, pressure_signals, classroom_signal,
       teacher_signal, growth_signal, priority_affected_learners,
       format_number(priority_affected_learners, 0) AS affected_txt, ap2_affected_learners, data_readiness,
       not_assessed_reason_txt
FROM pri
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:queue = 'All review statuses' OR queue_status = :queue) AND (:coverage = 'All LGUs' OR (:coverage = 'Assessed' AND queue_status <> 'Data review') OR (:coverage = 'Insufficient data' AND queue_status = 'Data review'))) AS r
GROUP BY lgu_type_label, queue_status

                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY national_order, city_mun_psgc_code) AS rank_in_view,
       national_order, city_mun_psgc_code, city_mun_name, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
       region_short, queue_status, queue_sort, status_label, status_basis, pressure_signals, classroom_signal,
       teacher_signal, growth_signal, priority_affected_learners,
       format_number(priority_affected_learners, 0) AS affected_txt, ap2_affected_learners, data_readiness,
       not_assessed_reason_txt
FROM pri
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:queue = 'All review statuses' OR queue_status = :queue) AND (:coverage = 'All LGUs' OR (:coverage = 'Assessed' AND queue_status <> 'Data review') OR (:coverage = 'Insufficient data' AND queue_status = 'Data review'))) AS r
WHERE queue_status = 'Data review'
ORDER BY lgu_label

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,

         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0

),

  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,

         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY priority_order) AS scope_order, COUNT(*) OVER () AS scope_total
  FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
)
SELECT p.lgu_label, p.city_mun_name, p.queue_status, p.status_label,
       p.queue_status || ' · ' || p.status_label || ': ' || p.status_basis AS status_line,
       p.lgu_type_label || ' · '
         || CASE WHEN p.province_label = 'Independent cities (no province)' THEN p.region_name ELSE p.province_label END
         || ' · National review order: ' || format_number(p.priority_order, 0) || ' of '
         || format_number((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pri), 0) || ' LGUs'
         || CASE WHEN (:region <> 'All regions' OR :province <> 'All provinces' OR :lgu_type <> 'All LGU types') THEN ' · ' || format_number(s.scope_order, 0) || ' of '
                 || format_number(s.scope_total, 0) || ' LGUs in current scope' ELSE '' END
         || ' · Data readiness: ' || p.data_readiness
         || CASE WHEN :lgu <> '(Top LGU in the filters)' AND p.lgu_label <> :lgu THEN ' · your choice is outside the filters, so this is the first LGU in them'
                 ELSE '' END AS details,
       -- each KPI is a short value; what it means is in the card's subtitle and the decision panel
       CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(p.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not assessed'
            ELSE format_number(COALESCE(p.congested_school_count, 0), 0) || ' of '
                 || format_number(COALESCE(p.ratio_school_count, 0), 0) END AS classroom_kpi,
       CASE WHEN p.levels_offered = 0 THEN 'None offered' WHEN p.levels_assessed = 0 THEN 'Not assessed'
            ELSE format_number(p.ap3_pressured_level_count, 0) || ' of ' || format_number(p.levels_assessed, 0) END
         AS teacher_kpi,
       CASE WHEN p.growing_enrollment IS NULL OR p.ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct IS NULL THEN 'Not comparable'
            ELSE CASE WHEN p.ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct / 100 >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || format_number(100 * p.ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct / 100, 1) || '%' END AS enrollment_kpi,
       CASE WHEN p.queue_status = 'Data review' THEN 'Data review'
            ELSE COALESCE(format_number(LEAST(p.ap2_learner_coverage_pct, p.teacher_coverage_pct), 0) || '%', 'Not available') END AS readiness_kpi,
       format_number(COALESCE(p.active_public_school_count, 0), 0) || ' public schools · '
         || COALESCE(format_number(p.reported_instructional_classrooms, 0), 'Not reported') || ' reported instructional rooms · '
         || format_number(COALESCE(p.es_teacher_count, 0) + COALESCE(p.jhs_teacher_count, 0)
                          + COALESCE(p.shs_teacher_count, 0), 0) || ' reported teachers · '
         || COALESCE(format_number(p.public_school_enrollment, 0), 'Not reported') || ' public learners · SY 2023-24' AS facts
FROM pri AS p
JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
LEFT JOIN scoped AS s ON s.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code

         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
p AS (SELECT pri.* FROM pri JOIN sel USING (city_mun_psgc_code))
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Classroom pressure' AS signal,
       CASE classroom_signal WHEN 'Present' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'Not identified' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS result,
       CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Under 90% of public learners are in schools with a usable room count'
            ELSE format_number(COALESCE(congested_school_count, 0), 0) || ' of ' || format_number(COALESCE(ratio_school_count, 0), 0)
                 || ' schools at or above 50 learners per reported room ('
                 || format_number(COALESCE(ap2_affected_learners, 0), 0) || ' learners, '
                 || COALESCE(format_number(ap2_affected_learner_share_pct, 1), '0.0') || '% of public learners), SY 2023-24' END AS basis
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'Teacher pressure',
       CASE teacher_signal WHEN 'Present' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'Not identified' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       CASE WHEN teacher_pressure_flag = 1
              THEN teacher_levels_above || ' above the published comparison point, SY 2023-24'
            WHEN COALESCE(ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'No offered level is above its comparison point, SY 2023-24'
            ELSE 'An offered level has under 90% of learners in schools with a teacher count' END
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'Enrollment growing',
       CASE growth_signal WHEN 'Growing' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'Not growing' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       CASE WHEN growing_enrollment IS NULL OR ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct IS NULL
              THEN 'Not comparable: ' || COALESCE(CASE growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE growth_not_assessed_reason END,
                                                  'boundaries or school years are incomplete')
            ELSE 'Public enrollment ' || CASE WHEN ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct / 100 >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || format_number(100 * ap4_public_enrollment_change_pct / 100, 1) || '%' || ' from SY 2020-21 to SY 2025-26 ('
                 || COALESCE(format_number(ap4_public_enrollment_first, 0), 'Not reported') || ' to ' || COALESCE(format_number(ap4_public_enrollment_latest, 0), 'Not reported') || ')' END
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'Review status', queue_status, status_label || ': ' || status_basis FROM p
ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: pr_evidence

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
p AS (SELECT pri.* FROM pri JOIN sel USING (city_mun_psgc_code))
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Classroom pressure · school screen' AS measure,
       CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not assessed'
            ELSE format_number(COALESCE(congested_school_count, 0), 0) || ' of ' || format_number(COALESCE(ratio_school_count, 0), 0)
                 || ' schools, ' || format_number(COALESCE(ap2_affected_learners, 0), 0) || ' learners' END AS this_lgu,
       'At or above 50 learners per reported room, school by school' AS comparison,
       CASE classroom_signal WHEN 'Present' THEN 'Signal present' WHEN 'Not identified' THEN 'No signal'
            ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS status,
       COALESCE(format_number(ap2_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available') AS coverage
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'Classroom pressure · all schools pooled', CASE WHEN ap2_learners_per_reported_room IS NULL THEN 'Not reported' ELSE format_number(ap2_learners_per_reported_room, 1) || ' learners per reported room' END,
       'Context: the school screen sets the signal', CASE WHEN ap2_assessed THEN 'Context' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       COALESCE(format_number(ap2_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available')
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'Teacher pressure · Elementary',
       CASE WHEN es_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—'
            ELSE CASE WHEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not reported' ELSE format_number(ap3_es_learners_per_teacher, 1) || ' learners per reported teacher' END END,
       'Comparison point ' || COALESCE(format_number(es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, 1), 'Not reported') || ' (historical study reference)',
       CASE WHEN es_offered_school_count = 0 THEN 'Not offered' WHEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN ap3_es_learners_per_teacher > es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher THEN 'Above comparison point' ELSE 'At or below comparison point' END,
       CASE WHEN es_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—' ELSE COALESCE(format_number(es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available') END
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'Teacher pressure · Junior high',
       CASE WHEN jhs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—'
            ELSE CASE WHEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not reported' ELSE format_number(ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher, 1) || ' learners per reported teacher' END END,
       'Comparison point ' || COALESCE(format_number(jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, 1), 'Not reported') || ' (derived deployment comparison)',
       CASE WHEN jhs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN 'Not offered' WHEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher > jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher THEN 'Above comparison point' ELSE 'At or below comparison point' END,
       CASE WHEN jhs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—' ELSE COALESCE(format_number(jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available') END
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'Teacher pressure · Senior high',
       CASE WHEN shs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—'
            ELSE CASE WHEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not reported' ELSE format_number(ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher, 1) || ' learners per reported teacher' END END,
       'Comparison point ' || COALESCE(format_number(shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, 1), 'Not reported') || ' (derived deployment comparison)',
       CASE WHEN shs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN 'Not offered' WHEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher > shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher THEN 'Above comparison point' ELSE 'At or below comparison point' END,
       CASE WHEN shs_offered_school_count = 0 THEN '—' ELSE COALESCE(format_number(shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available') END
FROM p
UNION ALL
SELECT 6, 'School network context', CASE WHEN ap1_learners_per_public_school IS NULL THEN 'Not reported' ELSE format_number(ap1_learners_per_public_school, 0) || ' learners per public school' END,
       'No published comparison point', 'Context only', COALESCE(format_number(ap1_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available')
FROM p
ORDER BY ord

                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
p AS (SELECT pri.* FROM pri JOIN sel USING (city_mun_psgc_code))
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Public schools' AS measure, COALESCE(format_number(ap1_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available') AS coverage,
       CASE WHEN ap1_assessed THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS assessed,
       '—' AS unusual_schools
FROM p
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Classrooms', COALESCE(format_number(ap2_learner_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available'),
       CASE WHEN ap2_assessed THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not assessed' END,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(missing_room_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(zero_room_school_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'None identified'
            ELSE format_number(COALESCE(missing_room_school_count, 0), 0) || ' with no room count, '
                 || format_number(COALESCE(zero_room_school_count, 0), 0) || ' with 0 rooms (left out of the screen)' END
FROM p
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Teachers', COALESCE(format_number(teacher_coverage_pct, 0) || '%', 'Not available'),
       CASE WHEN ap3_assessed THEN 'Assessed' ELSE 'Not fully assessed' END,
       CASE WHEN zero_teacher_annex_schools = 0 THEN 'None identified'
            ELSE format_number(zero_teacher_annex_schools, 0)
                 || CASE WHEN zero_teacher_annex_schools = 1 THEN ' annex school level' ELSE ' annex school levels' END
                 || ' with 0 teachers reported' END
FROM p
ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: pr_teachers
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
lv AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 1 AS ord, 'ES' AS lvl, es_offered_school_count AS offered, es_learners_per_teacher AS ratio,
         es_passes_gate AS passes, es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher AS reference FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
  UNION ALL SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 2, 'JHS', jhs_offered_school_count, jhs_learners_per_teacher, jhs_passes_gate,
         jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
  UNION ALL SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, 3, 'SHS', shs_offered_school_count, shs_learners_per_teacher, shs_passes_gate,
         shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure
)
SELECT ord, CASE lvl WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Elementary' WHEN 'JHS' THEN 'Junior high' ELSE 'Senior high' END AS level_axis,
       CASE WHEN ratio IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(passes, FALSE) THEN ratio / NULLIF(reference, 0) END AS share_of_comparison,
       CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(passes, FALSE) THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN ratio > reference THEN 'Above comparison point' ELSE 'At or below comparison point' END AS status
FROM lv JOIN sel USING (city_mun_psgc_code)
WHERE offered > 0

  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code

  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code

),
a AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.age = 5 THEN 'Kindergarten age (5)' WHEN p.age <= 11 THEN 'Elementary age (6-11)' WHEN p.age <= 15 THEN 'Junior high age (12-15)'
              ELSE 'Senior high age (16-17)' END AS age_band,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.reference_year = 2020 THEN p.population END) AS children_2020,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.reference_year = 2024 THEN p.population END) AS children_2024
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_city_school_age_population AS p JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = p.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE p.age BETWEEN 5 AND 17 AND p.sex IN ('male', 'female') AND p.reference_year IN (2020, 2024)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT age_band, children_2020, children_2024,
       (children_2024 - children_2020) / NULLIF(CAST(children_2020 AS DOUBLE), 0) AS change,
       CASE WHEN children_2020 IS NULL OR children_2024 IS NULL THEN 'Not available'
            WHEN children_2024 >= children_2020 THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS direction
FROM a
