         CASE WHEN s.annex_status <> 'Annex/Extension School' AND ((s.offers_es = 1 AND t.es_teachers = 0)
                   OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND t.jhs_teachers = 0) OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND t.shs_teachers = 0))
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_teachers_zero
  FROM sch AS s
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code AND b.member_type = 'regular'
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
  LEFT JOIN t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN years AS y ON y.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1 OR s.is_blank
),
z AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         f_above + f_rooms_missing + f_rooms_zero + f_learners_missing + f_teachers_missing + f_teachers_zero AS checks,
         -- a chosen level shows only its own ratio; the all-level ratio never stands in for a missing one
         CASE WHEN (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) IS NULL THEN learners_per_teacher
              ELSE learners_per_teacher_at_level END AS teacher_ratio,
         CASE WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Above classroom screen'
              WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_learners_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing figure'
              WHEN f_rooms_zero = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS status
  FROM x
),
schools AS (
  SELECT z.*, checks > 0 AS to_check,
         CASE WHEN checks > 0 THEN 'Verification needed' ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS verification_status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws('; ',
           CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing room count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms reported' END,
           CASE WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing learner count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing teacher count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero teachers reported' END,
           CASE WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Above classroom screen' END), ''), 'Included by classroom-pressure order') AS why_listed,
         CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Verify reported room count'
              WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Verify enrollment by level'
              WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Verify teacher count by level'
              WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Verify reported room count and enrollment'
              ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS verify_header,
         CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Ask the Schools Division Office for the room count'
              WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Confirm enrollment by level with the school'
              WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Confirm teachers by level with the Schools Division Office'
              WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Confirm rooms in use and enrollment with the school'
              ELSE 'No figure to verify' END AS next_step,
         COALESCE(format_number(learners, 0), 'Not reported') AS learners_txt,
         COALESCE(format_number(learners_per_room, 1), 'Not assessable') AS per_room_txt,
         COALESCE(format_number(teacher_ratio, 1), 'Not assessable') AS per_teacher_txt,
         CASE WHEN enrollment_change IS NULL THEN 'Incomplete trend' ELSE CASE WHEN enrollment_change >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || format_number(100 * enrollment_change, 1) || '%' END AS change_txt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN checks > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                     learners_per_room DESC NULLS LAST, school_name) AS list_order
  FROM z
)
SELECT list_order, school_name, school_id, barangay_name, levels_offered, levels_offered_full, per_room_txt, per_teacher_txt,
       verification_status, why_listed, next_step,
       learners, learners_per_room, teacher_ratio, enrollment_change, temporary_or_makeshift_rooms, locally_funded_teachers,
       school_kind, status
FROM schools
WHERE (:barangay = 'All barangays' OR barangay_name = :barangay) AND offers_level = 1 AND (:school_status = 'All schools' OR (:school_status = 'Verification needed' AND to_check) OR status = :school_status)
ORDER BY list_order

datasets.name: freshness
datasets.displayName: Data & Method: freshness and publication status
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT MAX(finished_at_utc) AS last_run FROM edu_access.`01-control`.pipeline_runs WHERE status = 'succeeded'
),
years AS (
  SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN source_id = 'deped_enrollment' AND has_data THEN school_year END) AS first_enrollment,
         MAX(CASE WHEN source_id = 'deped_enrollment' AND has_data THEN school_year END) AS last_enrollment,
         MAX(CASE WHEN source_id IN ('deped_facilities', 'deped_personnel') AND has_data THEN school_year END) AS last_capacity
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_year_source_availability
),
checks AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS checks, COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL') AS failed
  FROM (
    SELECT status FROM edu_access.`01-control`.data_quality_results
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY layer, table_name, check_name ORDER BY checked_at_utc DESC) = 1
  ) AS latest
)
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(CAST(runs.last_run AS DATE) AS STRING), 'Not available') AS updated,
       'Publication status: '
         || CASE WHEN checks.checks = 0 THEN 'No checks recorded' WHEN checks.failed > 0 THEN 'Needs attention' ELSE 'Ready' END
         || ' · enrollment SY ' || COALESCE(years.first_enrollment, 'not available') || ' to SY '
         || COALESCE(years.last_enrollment, 'not available')
         || ' · classrooms and teachers SY ' || COALESCE(years.last_capacity, 'not available')
         || ' · check counts are on the engineering data-quality dashboard' AS health_line
FROM runs CROSS JOIN years CROSS JOIN checks

datasets.name: dm_kpi
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
k AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS lgus,
         COUNT_IF(COALESCE(ap2_assessed, FALSE)) AS classroom_assessed,
         COUNT_IF(COALESCE(ap3_assessed, FALSE)) AS teacher_assessed,
         COUNT_IF(levels_offered > 0) AS offering,
         COUNT_IF(growing_enrollment IS NOT NULL) AS trends_comparable,
         COUNT_IF(queue_status = 'Data review') AS data_review
  FROM pri
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
)
SELECT k.*,
       format_number(classroom_assessed, 0) || ' of ' || format_number(lgus, 0) AS classroom_kpi,
       format_number(teacher_assessed, 0) || ' of ' || format_number(lgus, 0) AS teacher_kpi,
       format_number(trends_comparable, 0) || ' of ' || format_number(lgus, 0) AS trend_kpi,
       -- why this page's counts differ from the Overview's: an LGU keeps a review status when one measure is not
       -- fully assessed but another shows pressure
       CASE WHEN data_review = 0 THEN 'No LGU in this scope requires data review.'
            ELSE format_number(data_review, 0) || CASE WHEN data_review = 1 THEN ' LGU requires' ELSE ' LGUs require' END
                 || ' data review; the other ' || format_number(lgus - data_review, 0)
                 || ' have a review status, some with one measure not fully assessed.' END AS alert_line
FROM k

queryLines:

datasets.name: dm_ap4
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
ap4_complete AS (
  SELECT city_mun_psgc_code, MAX(CASE WHEN schools_incomplete > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete,
         MIN(CASE WHEN is_2020_2024_geography_comparable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comparable
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap4_enrollment_trend WHERE member_type = 'regular' GROUP BY city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.incomplete = 1 THEN 'An incomplete school year' WHEN c.comparable = 0 THEN 'Boundaries changed 2020 to 2024'
            ELSE 'Complete and comparable' END AS ap4_status,
       COUNT(*) AS lgus
FROM lgu AS l JOIN ap4_complete AS c ON c.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
GROUP BY 1

                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
c AS (
  SELECT 'Public schools' AS measure, ap1_coverage_pct AS coverage FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Classrooms', ap2_learner_coverage_pct FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Teachers · Elementary', es_learner_coverage_pct FROM pri WHERE es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Teachers · Junior high', jhs_learner_coverage_pct FROM pri WHERE jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Teachers · Senior high', shs_learner_coverage_pct FROM pri WHERE shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
),
b AS (
  SELECT measure,
         CASE WHEN coverage IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN coverage < 90 THEN 'Incomplete (under 90%)'
              ELSE 'Assessed (90% or more)' END AS coverage_status
  FROM c
  WHERE (:measure = 'All measures' OR measure = :measure OR (measure LIKE 'Teachers%' AND :measure = 'Teachers'))
)
SELECT measure, coverage_status, COUNT(*) AS lgus, COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY measure) AS share
FROM b
GROUP BY measure, coverage_status

datasets.name: dm_reasons
datasets.displayName: Data & Method: why LGUs need data review
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
-- the data review LGUs only, by the input that could not be checked
r AS (
  SELECT 'Classrooms' AS measure, a.not_assessed_reason AS reason
  FROM pri JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a USING (city_mun_psgc_code) WHERE pri.queue_status = 'Data review' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR pri.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR pri.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR pri.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Teachers', a.not_assessed_reason
  FROM pri JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a USING (city_mun_psgc_code) WHERE pri.queue_status = 'Data review' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR pri.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR pri.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR pri.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Enrollment trend', growth_not_assessed_reason FROM pri WHERE queue_status = 'Data review' AND (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
)
SELECT measure, CASE reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE reason END AS reason, COUNT(*) AS lgus
FROM r
WHERE reason IS NOT NULL AND (:measure = 'All measures' OR measure = :measure)
GROUP BY 1, 2

  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(ap2_affected_learners, 0) = 0 THEN 'No school above the screen'
            WHEN ap2_affected_learner_share_pct < 10 THEN 'Under 10%'
            WHEN ap2_affected_learner_share_pct < 25 THEN '10-25%'
            WHEN ap2_affected_learner_share_pct < 50 THEN '25-50%' ELSE '50% or more' END AS share_band,
       COUNT(*) AS lgus
FROM pri
WHERE ap2_assessed AND (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: dm_teacher_levels
datasets.displayName: Data & Method: teacher-pressure assessment by level
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.region_short, m.*,
         m.priority_category AS queue_status,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Immediate joint review' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'High-priority review' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'Targeted review' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Growth watchlist' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No current pressure identified' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data to assess' END AS status_label,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 'Classroom and teacher pressure are present, and enrollment is growing' WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 'Both pressure signals are present, or one pressure signal is present with growing enrollment' WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 'One pressure signal is present without growing enrollment' WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 'Enrollment is growing, but no current pressure signal was identified' WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 'No pressure signal or enrollment growth was identified from available data' WHEN 'Data review' THEN 'Coverage or growth data are incomplete and no known pressure signal is present' END AS status_basis,
         CASE m.priority_category WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 0 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 2 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 3 WHEN 'No current pressure identified' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS queue_sort,
         m.priority_order AS national_order,
         CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS classroom_signal,
         -- the published flag: a signal at one level stands even if another offered level is short of coverage
         CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Present' WHEN COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE) THEN 'Not identified'
              ELSE 'Not assessed' END AS teacher_signal,
         CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Growing' WHEN NOT m.growing_enrollment THEN 'Not growing'
              ELSE 'Not comparable' END AS growth_signal,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.classroom_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Classroom' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.teacher_pressure_flag = 1 THEN 'Teacher' END), ''),
                  'None identified') AS pressure_signals,
         CASE WHEN m.priority_category = 'Data review' THEN 'Insufficient data'
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE) OR NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   OR m.growing_enrollment IS NULL THEN 'Partly assessed'
              ELSE 'Assessed' END AS data_readiness,
         concat_ws('; ',
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap2_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a2.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a2.not_assessed_reason END, 'Classrooms not assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.ap3_assessed, FALSE)
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE a3.not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE a3.not_assessed_reason END, 'Teachers not fully assessed') END,
              CASE WHEN m.growing_enrollment IS NULL
                   THEN COALESCE(CASE m.growth_not_assessed_reason WHEN 'no active public school' THEN 'No active public school' WHEN 'no school with complete enrollment' THEN 'No school with complete enrollment' WHEN 'coverage below 90%' THEN 'School coverage below 90%' WHEN 'learner coverage below 90%' THEN 'Classroom learner coverage below 90%' WHEN 'no usable classroom denominator' THEN 'No usable room count' WHEN 'no active public school level' THEN 'No active public school level' WHEN 'an offered level is below 90% learner coverage' THEN 'At least one offered level has teacher coverage below 90%' WHEN 'boundary changed 2020-2024' THEN 'Geographic boundaries changed' WHEN 'public enrollment incomplete in first or latest school year' THEN 'Enrollment trend incomplete' WHEN 'no 2024 census population row' THEN 'No 2024 census population' WHEN 'no AP4 enrollment row' THEN 'No enrollment trend for this LGU' WHEN 'no public enrollment in first school year' THEN 'No public enrollment in the first school year' ELSE m.growth_not_assessed_reason END, 'Enrollment trend not comparable')
                   END) AS not_assessed_reason_txt,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Elementary' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Junior high' END,
                         CASE WHEN a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%' THEN 'Senior high' END) AS teacher_levels_above,
         a1.active_public_school_count, a1.public_school_enrollment,
         a2.congested_school_count, a2.ratio_school_count, a2.missing_room_school_count, a2.zero_room_school_count,
         a2.reported_instructional_classrooms, a2.eligible_learners,
         a3.es_offered_school_count, a3.jhs_offered_school_count, a3.shs_offered_school_count,
         a3.es_teacher_count, a3.jhs_teacher_count, a3.shs_teacher_count,
         a3.es_passes_gate, a3.jhs_passes_gate, a3.shs_passes_gate,
         a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct,
         a3.es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher, a3.jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         a3.shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS levels_offered,
         CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.es_passes_gate OR a3.es_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.jhs_passes_gate OR a3.jhs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 AND (a3.shs_passes_gate OR a3.shs_benchmark_status LIKE 'above%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           AS levels_assessed,
         COALESCE(a3.es_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) + COALESCE(a3.jhs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0)
           + COALESCE(a3.shs_zero_teacher_annex_school_count, 0) AS zero_teacher_annex_schools,
         NULLIF(LEAST(CASE WHEN a3.es_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.es_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.jhs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.jhs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END,
                      CASE WHEN a3.shs_offered_school_count > 0 THEN COALESCE(a3.shs_learner_coverage_pct, 0) ELSE 999 END),
                999) AS teacher_coverage_pct
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap1_school_provision AS a1 ON a1.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap2_classroom_pressure AS a2 ON a2.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.ap3_teacher_pressure AS a3 ON a3.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
lv AS (
  SELECT 'Elementary' AS level, es_offered_school_count AS offered, ap3_es_learners_per_teacher AS ratio,
         es_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher AS reference FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Junior high', jhs_offered_school_count, ap3_jhs_learners_per_teacher, jhs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher
  FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Senior high', shs_offered_school_count, ap3_shs_learners_per_teacher, shs_benchmark_max_learners_per_teacher
  FROM pri WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
)
SELECT level, CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 'Not assessed' WHEN ratio > reference THEN 'Above comparison point'
                   ELSE 'At or below comparison point' END AS status,
       COUNT(*) AS lgus, COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS share
FROM lv
WHERE offered > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: dm_sources
queryLines:
SELECT source, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2020-21' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2020_21,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2021-22' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2021_22,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2022-23' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2022_23,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2023-24' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2023_24,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2024-25' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2024_25,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN school_year = '2025-26' AND has_data THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not available' END AS sy_2025_26
FROM (
  SELECT school_year, has_data,
         CASE source_id WHEN 'deped_enrollment' THEN 'Enrollment' WHEN 'deped_facilities' THEN 'Classrooms (facilities)'
              WHEN 'deped_personnel' THEN 'Teachers (personnel)' ELSE source_id END AS source
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_year_source_availability
) AS a
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY source

datasets.name: opt_school
queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name,
         CASE WHEN instr(d.region_name, '(') > 0
              THEN substring(d.region_name, instr(d.region_name, '(') + 1,
                             instr(d.region_name, ')') - instr(d.region_name, '(') - 1)
              ELSE d.region_name END AS region_short,
         CASE WHEN lower(d.lgu_type) = 'city' THEN 'City' ELSE 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.priority_order, l.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
lvl AS (SELECT CASE WHEN :level = 'All levels' THEN NULL ELSE CASE :level WHEN 'Elementary' THEN 'ES' WHEN 'Junior high' THEN 'JHS' WHEN 'Senior high' THEN 'SHS' END END AS level_code),
e AS (
  SELECT e.* FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment AS e JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = e.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE e.sector = 'Public' AND e.psgc_match_status = 'matched'
),
sch AS (
  SELECT school_id, MAX(barangay_psgc_code) AS barangay_psgc_code, MAX(annex_status) AS annex_status,
         MAX(CASE WHEN is_offered AND learner_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_active,
         COUNT_IF(is_offered) > 0 AND COUNT_IF(is_offered AND learner_count IS NOT NULL) = 0 AS is_blank,
         COUNT_IF(is_offered AND learner_count IS NULL) AS incomplete_levels,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_offered AND learner_count IS NOT NULL THEN learner_count ELSE 0 END) AS learners,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'ES' AND is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'JHS' AND is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_jhs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'SHS' AND is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_shs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'ES' AND is_offered THEN learner_count END) AS es_learners,
         SUM(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'JHS' AND is_offered THEN learner_count END) AS jhs_learners,
         SUM(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'SHS' AND is_offered THEN learner_count END) AS shs_learners
  FROM e WHERE school_year = '2023-24' GROUP BY school_id
),
years AS (
  SELECT school_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN school_year = '2020-21' AND is_offered THEN learner_count END) AS learners_2020,
         SUM(CASE WHEN school_year = '2025-26' AND is_offered THEN learner_count END) AS learners_2025,
         COUNT_IF(school_year IN ('2020-21', '2025-26') AND is_offered AND learner_count IS NULL) AS incomplete_ends
  FROM e GROUP BY school_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT school_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'ES' THEN teacher_count END) AS es_teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'JHS' THEN teacher_count END) AS jhs_teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN education_level_code = 'SHS' THEN teacher_count END) AS shs_teachers,
         SUM(COALESCE(sef_provincial_teacher_count, 0) + COALESCE(sef_city_municipal_teacher_count, 0)
             + COALESCE(lgu_funded_teacher_count, 0) + COALESCE(other_funded_teacher_count, 0)) AS locally_funded_teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_teacher_capacity WHERE school_year = '2023-24' GROUP BY school_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(ds.school_name, s.school_id) AS school_name, b.barangay_psgc_code,
         COALESCE(b.barangay_name, 'Barangay not matched') AS barangay_name,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status = 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 'Annex' ELSE 'Main' END AS school_kind,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'ES' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'JHS' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'SHS' END) AS levels_offered,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'Elementary' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'Junior high' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'Senior high' END) AS levels_offered_full,
         s.offers_es, s.offers_jhs, s.offers_shs, s.es_learners, s.jhs_learners, s.shs_learners,
         CASE WHEN s.incomplete_levels = 0 THEN s.learners END AS learners,
         r.instructional_classrooms_total AS rooms,
         COALESCE(r.temporary_learning_spaces, 0) + COALESCE(r.makeshift_rooms, 0) AS temporary_or_makeshift_rooms,
         r.temporary_learning_spaces, r.makeshift_rooms,
         CASE WHEN s.incomplete_levels = 0 AND r.instructional_classrooms_total > 0
              THEN s.learners / CAST(r.instructional_classrooms_total AS DOUBLE) END AS learners_per_room,
         t.es_teachers, t.jhs_teachers, t.shs_teachers, COALESCE(t.locally_funded_teachers, 0) AS locally_funded_teachers,
         COALESCE(t.es_teachers, 0) + COALESCE(t.jhs_teachers, 0) + COALESCE(t.shs_teachers, 0) AS teachers,
         (CASE WHEN t.es_teachers > 0 THEN COALESCE(s.es_learners, 0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN t.jhs_teachers > 0 THEN COALESCE(s.jhs_learners, 0) ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN t.shs_teachers > 0 THEN COALESCE(s.shs_learners, 0) ELSE 0 END)
          / NULLIF(CAST(CASE WHEN t.es_teachers > 0 THEN t.es_teachers ELSE 0 END
                        + CASE WHEN t.jhs_teachers > 0 THEN t.jhs_teachers ELSE 0 END
                        + CASE WHEN t.shs_teachers > 0 THEN t.shs_teachers ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher,
         CASE (SELECT level_code FROM lvl)
              WHEN 'ES' THEN s.es_learners / NULLIF(CAST(t.es_teachers AS DOUBLE), 0)
              WHEN 'JHS' THEN s.jhs_learners / NULLIF(CAST(t.jhs_teachers AS DOUBLE), 0)
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN s.shs_learners / NULLIF(CAST(t.shs_teachers AS DOUBLE), 0) END AS learners_per_teacher_at_level,
         CASE WHEN y.incomplete_ends = 0 AND y.learners_2020 > 0
              THEN (y.learners_2025 - y.learners_2020) / CAST(y.learners_2020 AS DOUBLE) END AS enrollment_change,
         CASE (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) WHEN 'ES' THEN s.offers_es WHEN 'JHS' THEN s.offers_jhs
              WHEN 'SHS' THEN s.offers_shs ELSE 1 END AS offers_level,
         -- one flag per figure to verify; a flag means verify, not incorrect
         CASE WHEN s.incomplete_levels = 0 AND r.instructional_classrooms_total > 0
                   AND s.learners / CAST(r.instructional_classrooms_total AS DOUBLE) >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_above,
         CASE WHEN r.school_id IS NULL OR r.instructional_classrooms_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_rooms_missing,
         CASE WHEN r.instructional_classrooms_total = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_rooms_zero,
         CASE WHEN s.incomplete_levels > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_learners_missing,
         CASE WHEN (s.offers_es = 1 AND t.es_teachers IS NULL) OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND t.jhs_teachers IS NULL)
                   OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND t.shs_teachers IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_teachers_missing,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status <> 'Annex/Extension School' AND ((s.offers_es = 1 AND t.es_teachers = 0)
                   OR (s.offers_jhs = 1 AND t.jhs_teachers = 0) OR (s.offers_shs = 1 AND t.shs_teachers = 0))
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS f_teachers_zero
  FROM sch AS s
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code AND b.member_type = 'regular'
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
  LEFT JOIN t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN years AS y ON y.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1 OR s.is_blank
),
z AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         f_above + f_rooms_missing + f_rooms_zero + f_learners_missing + f_teachers_missing + f_teachers_zero AS checks,
         -- a chosen level shows only its own ratio; the all-level ratio never stands in for a missing one
         CASE WHEN (SELECT level_code FROM lvl) IS NULL THEN learners_per_teacher
              ELSE learners_per_teacher_at_level END AS teacher_ratio,
         CASE WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Above classroom screen'
              WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_learners_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing figure'
              WHEN f_rooms_zero = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS status
  FROM x
),
schools AS (
  SELECT z.*, checks > 0 AS to_check,
         CASE WHEN checks > 0 THEN 'Verification needed' ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS verification_status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws('; ',
           CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing room count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms reported' END,
           CASE WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing learner count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing teacher count' END,
           CASE WHEN f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero teachers reported' END,
           CASE WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Above classroom screen' END), ''), 'Included by classroom-pressure order') AS why_listed,
         CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Verify reported room count'
              WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Verify enrollment by level'
              WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Verify teacher count by level'
              WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Verify reported room count and enrollment'
              ELSE 'No verification flag' END AS verify_header,
         CASE WHEN f_rooms_missing = 1 OR f_rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'Ask the Schools Division Office for the room count'
              WHEN f_learners_missing = 1 THEN 'Confirm enrollment by level with the school'
              WHEN f_teachers_missing = 1 OR f_teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Confirm teachers by level with the Schools Division Office'
              WHEN f_above = 1 THEN 'Confirm rooms in use and enrollment with the school'
              ELSE 'No figure to verify' END AS next_step,
         COALESCE(format_number(learners, 0), 'Not reported') AS learners_txt,
         COALESCE(format_number(learners_per_room, 1), 'Not assessable') AS per_room_txt,
         COALESCE(format_number(teacher_ratio, 1), 'Not assessable') AS per_teacher_txt,
         CASE WHEN enrollment_change IS NULL THEN 'Incomplete trend' ELSE CASE WHEN enrollment_change >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || format_number(100 * enrollment_change, 1) || '%' END AS change_txt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN checks > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                     learners_per_room DESC NULLS LAST, school_name) AS list_order
  FROM z
)
SELECT school_option FROM (
  SELECT '(First school to verify)' AS school_option, 0 AS s
  UNION ALL SELECT school_name || ' · ' || school_id, 1 FROM schools WHERE offers_level = 1
) AS o ORDER BY s, school_option

lines:
## What this dashboard cannot tell you

- **How many resources to add.** The review order is not an official shortage, staffing entitlement, construction need or funding allocation.
- **Room condition or use.** Reported rooms do not show condition, shifts or utilization.
- **Travel or access.** Enrollment is counted at the school, not where learners live.

Full methodology: the dashboards README in the project repository.
